turns.user_query: What about the doors in those walls?
turns.rewritten_query: What are the fire resistance rating and opening protection requirements for doors in boiler room separation walls under the National Building Code of India?
turns.assistant_answer: Under the National Building Code of India (Part 4, Clause 6.1.1.4) [Volume 1, PDF p. 315], openings in walls separating a boiler room must be protected by self-closing fire doors with a minimum fire resistance rating of 120 minutes (2 hours). Ventilation openings or louvers are prohibited in these fire doors unless protected by certified automatic fire dampers [Volume 1, PDF p. 315].
